title: Hedgehog's Glow-in-the-Dark Picnic
originalStory: A tiny hedgehog found a lantern mushroom in the garden and used its glow to host a night picnic for shy forest friends.
visualBible: A tiny hedgehog with soft spines and curious eyes. Forest friends include a shy rabbit with floppy ears, a timid squirrel with a bushy tail, and a gentle owl with wide wings.

pages.text: In the quiet garden, a tiny hedgehog discovered a glowing mushroom, its warm light casting sparkles on the leaves. 'This will be perfect for a night picnic!' Hedgehog chirped, eyes bright with excitement.
pages.illustrationScene: A tiny hedgehog stands in a moonlit garden, gazing at a glowing mushroom nestled among the dewy grass. No other characters are present.

pages.text: Hedgehog placed the lantern mushroom at the picnic spot and called softly, 'Rabbit, Squirrel, Owl, come see!' Slowly, the shy friends emerged from the shadows, curiosity guiding their steps.
pages.illustrationScene: In a cozy forest clearing, the hedgehog places the glowing mushroom on a checkered cloth. Rabbit peeks from behind a tree, Squirrel tiptoes closer, and Owl perches on a low branch.

pages.text: As they gathered under the glow, Hedgehog smiled, 'Isn't it magical?' The forest friends nodded, feeling brave and warm, sharing stories under their new light. Together, they sparkled brighter than the stars.
pages.illustrationScene: All four friends sit around the glowing mushroom in a circle. Their faces are lit with joy as they share stories, surrounded by twinkling stars in the night sky.
